title: Parables and the Calming of the Storm

questions.question: In the Parable of the Sower, what happened to the seed that fell along the path?
options: The birds came and devoured it
It grew immediately but had no roots
The thorns choked it out
Someone stepped on it and crushed it
questions.correctAnswer: The birds came and devoured it
questions.explanation: Mark 4:4 (ESV): "And as he sowed, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it."

questions.question: Why did the seed sown on rocky ground wither away when the sun rose?
options: Because it had no root
Because the soil was too salty
Because the birds dug it up
Because it was washed away by rain
questions.explanation: Mark 4:5-6 (ESV): "...and when the sun rose, it was scorched, and since it had no root, it withered away."

questions.question: What did the seed sown among thorns do?
options: The thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no grain
It produced a small amount of sour grain
It overpowered the thorns eventually
It grew tall but bore no leaves
questions.correctAnswer: The thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no grain
questions.explanation: Mark 4:7 (ESV): "Other seed fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no grain."

questions.question: According to Jesus, to whom is the secret of the kingdom of God given?
options: To the twelve and those around Him
To the Pharisees and scribes
To those who are completely righteous
To the Roman authorities
questions.correctAnswer: To the twelve and those around Him
questions.explanation: Mark 4:10-11 (ESV): "And when he was alone, those around him with the twelve asked him about the parables. And he said to them, 'To you has been given the secret of the kingdom of God...'"

questions.question: For those outside, everything is in parables quoting Isaiah so that, "they may indeed see but not perceive, and may indeed hear but not understand, lest..." what?
options: "...lest they should turn and be forgiven."
"...lest they should use it for power."
"...lest they build a false kingdom."
"...lest they teach the Gentiles."
questions.correctAnswer: "...lest they should turn and be forgiven."
questions.explanation: Mark 4:12 (ESV): "so that 'they may indeed see but not perceive, and may indeed hear but not understand, lest they should turn and be forgiven.'"

questions.question: In the explanation of the Parable of the Sower, the seed sown among thorns represents those who hear the word, but what happens?
options: The cares of the world, deceitfulness of riches, and desires for other things choke the word
They are offended when persecution text arises
Satan immediately snatches it away
They forget it when they return to their homes
questions.correctAnswer: The cares of the world, deceitfulness of riches, and desires for other things choke the word
questions.explanation: Mark 4:18-19 (ESV): "...but the cares of the world and the deceitfulness of riches and the desires for other things enter in and choke the word, and it proves unfruitful."

questions.question: Jesus asks if a lamp is brought in to be put under a basket or a bed. Where should a lamp be put?
options: On a stand
In a window
In the middle of the floor
Outside the door
questions.explanation: Mark 4:21 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'Is a lamp brought in to be put under a basket, or under a bed, and not on a stand?'"

questions.question: What is the promise Jesus makes regarding secrets? "For nothing is hidden except to be made manifest; nor is anything secret except..."
options: "...to come to light."
"...to be spoken in the ears."
"...to be scattered to the wind."
"...to be revealed at judgment."
questions.explanation: Mark 4:22 (ESV): "For nothing is hidden except to be made manifest; nor is anything secret except to come to light."

questions.question: Complete Jesus' statement: "Pay attention to what you hear: with the measure you use, it will be measured to you, and..."
options: "...still more will be added to you."
"...your cup will run over."
"...your enemies will be judged by it."
"...your debts will be forgiven."
questions.correctAnswer: "...still more will be added to you."
questions.explanation: Mark 4:24 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'Pay attention to what you hear: with the measure you use, it will be measured to you, and still more will be added to you.'"

questions.question: In the Parable of the Growing Seed, a man scatters seed on the ground, sleeps, and rises. How does the seed sprout and grow?
options: He knows not how; the earth produces by itself
He waters it daily with his tears
He sings to it every morning
The angels tend to it by night
questions.correctAnswer: He knows not how; the earth produces by itself
questions.explanation: Mark 4:27-28 (ESV): "...he knows not how. The earth produces by itself, first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear."

questions.question: With what small seed does Jesus compare the kingdom of God, which grows to put out large branches?
options: A grain of mustard seed
An acorn
A cedar seed
A cumin seed
questions.explanation: Mark 4:31-32 (ESV): "It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when sown on the ground, is the smallest of all the seeds on earth, yet when it is sown it grows up..."

questions.question: Later that day, when evening had come, Jesus proposed going across to the other side of the sea. What happened while they were in the boat?
options: A great windstorm arose, and the waves were breaking into the boat
The boat sprang a leak from a hidden rock
They were attacked by pirates on the lake
The winds died completely, leaving them stranded
questions.correctAnswer: A great windstorm arose, and the waves were breaking into the boat
questions.explanation: Mark 4:37 (ESV): "And a great windstorm arose, and the waves were breaking into the boat, so that the boat was already filling."

questions.question: Where was Jesus and what was He doing during the great windstorm?
options: He was in the stern, asleep on the cushion
He was praying loudly in the bow of the boat
He was bailing water with the disciples
He was standing on the water beside the boat
questions.correctAnswer: He was in the stern, asleep on the cushion
questions.explanation: Mark 4:38 (ESV): "But he was in the stern, asleep on the cushion. And they woke him and said to him, 'Teacher, do you not care that we are perishing?'"

questions.question: What words did Jesus use to rebuke the wind and the sea, resulting in a great calm?
options: "Peace! Be still!"
"Stop your raging!"
"Let there be calm!"
"Quiet, you winds!"
questions.explanation: Mark 4:39 (ESV): "And he awoke and rebuked the wind and said to the sea, 'Peace! Be still!' And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm."

questions.question: After the storm was calmed, what did the terrified disciples say to one another?
options: "Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?"
"He is truly the Prophet from Moses."
"Did you see what magic he worked?"
"We must never sail with him again."
questions.correctAnswer: "Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?"
questions.explanation: Mark 4:41 (ESV): "And they were filled with great fear and said to one another, 'Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?'"

key_verse_text: And he awoke and rebuked the wind and said to the sea, "Peace! Be still!" And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
